name: netdust-gates
description: 0.3.0: the smoke registry — shakeout-qa leaves a fixture-free, read-only @smoke spec per surface and a row in specs/SMOKE.md; shakeout-check fails a driven feature that left no row, a row whose test is missing, a test without the tag; /shakeout reads the registry first. 0.2.0: /plan-review — a fresh plan-reviewer subagent ground-truths the plan's premises against the source before Stefan reads it, files specs/<f>/plan-review.md naming the plan's blob, and the guard refuses product code while a plan open on this branch has no review of its current text. Netdust's software-delivery policy over superpowers: standards injected into the spec and plan, verification by executables (make gate, the shake-out manifest check), authority hooks. Pilot on netdust.be; replaces netdust-agent there and never runs beside it.
